name: AiInlineSuggestion
title: Components/AI/AiInlineSuggestion
description: Offer a proposed field value while keeping acceptance under user control.
purpose: Offer a proposed field value while keeping acceptance under user control.
usage: suggestion is the complete proposed value. Tab or the Accept button applies it; Escape dismisses it. Field context supplies labels and validation.

props.name: suggestion
props.description: Full proposed value, including the already typed prefix.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Indicates the entered value does not conform to the format expected by the application.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
